reviews.title: The LEGO Discovery Shuttle Kit
reviews.body: This is quite fantastic kit, because it comes with both the space shuttle and the hubble space telescope.  The build has a very in-depth instructional manual with an easy follow direction.  *CAVEAT-A:  The instructions MUST BE READ VERY CAREFULLY.  During the course of assembly, a few small parts were missing, but you can compensate with similar Lego part leftovers.  Both build/kits (shuttle and Hubble) have movable parts (wing flaps, landing gear, antennae array, elevons, bay areas and cockpit). *CAVEAT-B:  The moveable parts assemble REQUIRES SPECIAL ATTENTION TO DETAIL INSTRUCTIONAL STEPS.  This very same kit comes with (3) three display stands for both models.  These stands are one of the most solid builds of these spacecrafts.  The builds for the Shuttle's delta wings, forward and mid fuselage and cargo carrier does require more in-depth builds as well.  Placement of the Shuttle's tiles (outer covering of the spacecraft) should be also focused.  Overall, the completed Shuttle is impressive, large and sturdy, but must be careful in handling.  A definite 5 and 6 stars comments.

features: LEGO NASA Space Set - This adult LEGO set features the Space Shuttle Discovery and the Hubble Space Telescope from NASA’s 1990 STS-31 mission, perfect for space enthusiasts.
Solar System Exploration - Unlock the mysteries of our solar system with this engaging 2,354-piece project, packed with authentic details and NASA-inspired elements.
Shuttle Features Galore - The space shuttle model has an opening payload bay, retractable landing gear, opening cockpit, moving elevons, space arm, and 5 seats for the crew.
Hubble Telescope Replica - Part of the LEGO spaceship collection, the Hubble Space Telescope features movable solar panels and a hatch door, just like the real thing.
Impressive Space Model - Measuring over 54 cm (21 in.) long, this LEGO space shuttle from a series of collectible building kits for adults makes a great gift for space enthusiasts.
Eye-catching Display - With multiple display stands, this space shuttle model makes an eye-catching centerpiece for the home or office, perfect for fans of NASA and space exploration.
Cockpit and Crew Seating - The cockpit opens to reveal a flight deck with crew seating, allowing you to explore life on board the Discovery spaceship and the base plate bears mission facts.
